newsitem.title: USA: Possis' AngioJet, Perma-Seal get European approval.
newsitem.headline: Possis' AngioJet, Perma-Seal get European approval.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc said Monday it received CE Mark approval for its AngioJet Rapid Thrombectomy System for peripheral applications and its Perma-Seal Dialysis Access Graft, allowing the products to be sold throughout the European Union.
The CE Mark approval is still pending, however, for coronary applications of the AngioJet and for the Perma-Flow Coronary Bypass Graft, the company said.
"These devices are in a different category and require a more extensive review," the company said in a statement. "A favorable final response is expected for these products soon."
The company said it expects the approval to aid marketing efforts and to help increase sales. The European Union is one of the largest markets for medical devices in the world.
The AngioJet is used to rapidly remove blood clots. The Perma-Seal is an artificial blood vessel used for vascular access in kidney dialysis patients.
Possis provides medical devices for the cardiovascular and vascular treatment markets.
